description_html:
**This mod will not be updated to SPT 3.11.x and beyond as I do not own the original assets and cannot create new bundles for unity 2022.

README

This mod is a re-uploaded version of SamSWAT’s Anime Rear Sights that is updated to work on SPT versions 3.9.0, 3.9.1, and 3.9.2 The original mod is mostly working, but requires editing json, and I know some don’t want to deal with that, so this re-uploaded version works right out of the box without any editing by the user required. I DO NOT OWN any of this material as this mod was originally created by SamSWAT. Check out the original mod: Anime Rear Sights

Adds variety of edited rear sights with the weeb art at the back. That’s it. Items sold by loyalty level 1 Mechanic and flea market

How To Install

Open the downloaded zip file then drag and drop the ‘user’ folder into your SPT directory

—CREDITS—

Girls Frontline M4 SOPMOD II - ApertureAwesome.

Ai Fuyuumi - Farengar, tac.error, Rymd.

Art for Anti 1 & 2 by Sumerikan.

And one more unknown artist.

SamSWAT originally had a donation button here, but the link is dead so i removed it

All sights can be found in raid in weapon boxes, wooden crates, duffle bags, and ground caches

Mechanic Loyalty Level 1 stock

PS: I’m not a big anime fan, but this is an OG Tarkov mod made by an awesome dev. I didn’t want it to get lost forever
